__comment: Overrides Scorchful's own Nether environment to make the Nether hot everywhere.
Scorchful grades the Nether by altitude: scorchful:sea_level_altitude_temperature, 50 C at the
Nether's sea level of y 32, falling 1.5 C per block for the first 20 blocks above it. That puts
y 42 exactly on the 35 C heat threshold and anything at or above y 52 at 20 C - so standing on
the Nether's surface, where players actually walk, produced no heat at all. Only the lava seas
This pack's design says the Nether is hot, full stop. So the base becomes a flat 50 C at every
height. Scorchful's own nether_modifiers tag is kept, which is what still adds +10 C in bright
block light, so standing in front of lava is hotter than standing in a dark tunnel.
Humidity is deliberately not set here. Scorchful handles that separately in
thermoo/environment/humidity/hell.json, and setting it in this file would silently replace it.
To restore Scorchful's graded behaviour, delete this file.
